summary: One-line fix changes `return variable_attrs[0]` to `return dict(variable_attrs[0])`, making `combine_attrs='override'` return a copy instead of a reference, exactly matching the pattern already used by the other combine_attrs branches. Correctly and minimally resolves the reported aliasing bug.

issues.description: dict() is a shallow copy, so nested mutable attr values remain shared between source and merged product. This matches the behavior of the other combine_attrs branches (e.g. no_conflicts also uses dict()), so it is consistent and not a regression, but deep mutation of nested attrs would still alias.
